instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the opened Blender graphical user interface. Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, or any shell; do not run Python, bpy scripts, Text Editor scripts, Geometry Nodes exported scripts, or blender --background automation that directly generates or edits the deliverable files. Do not install or run helper add-ons that auto-build the required result. Use only Blender native GUI tools, menus, editors, and built-in save/export commands. UV Cross-Seam Unwrap `scene.blend` contains mesh `Cube` with no UV layer and no seams. Mark a seam layout that unfolds the cube into a cross-style unwrap, unwrap it with the Angle-Based method, pack the islands, and save the scene as `answer.blend`. Requirements: `Cube` must end up with at least one UV layer; between 5 and 9 edges must be marked as seams; all UV coordinates must lie within `[0,1]^2` within epsilon `0.01`; the UV bounding box must span at least `0.60` in one dimension and `0.40` in the other; UV overlap must remain below 1% on the required grid test; and the island count must be between 1 and 6.
